works.title: Dystopian Novel: Concentrated AI Governance
works.description: A dystopian narrative exploring what happens if artificial intelligence or assisted human intelligence is allowed to concentrate. The plot hinges on an inflection event where emergency-justified surveillance precedents enable permanent expansion of oversight-bypass, with reader positioned to argue both sides of the moral dilemma.
works.quote: I need to create a dystopian vision of what would happen if artificial intelligence or assisted human intelligence were allowed to be concentrated

works.title: Brand Tax Political Media Campaign
works.description: A three-year coordinated left-wing media and meme campaign designed to systematically expose Republican brand contradictions through juxtaposed imagery and innuendo. Infrastructure includes unified style guide (2-3 fonts, 2-3 layout templates, recurring visual motifs), production loop, repeating slogans, and distribution strategy with Streisand-effect leverage.
works.quote: There was a concerted left-wing effort to put out memes and images that constantly juxtapose opposing forces and expose the rot. It gets to run for three full years nonstop
